title.narrative: Afghanistan?s economy is gradually recovering, but at a slow pace, and the outlook remains uncertain due to fiscal pressures, a widening trade deficit, and persistent poverty and food insecurity, says the World Bank?s latest development report (April 2025). Poverty and food insecurity remain pressing challenges, exacerbated by high unemployment and restrictions on women's economic participation. UNICEF continues to generate evidence to support evidence based planning, for instance in June 2025, UNICEF published multidimensional poverty report sharped the integration and covergence strategy for 2026-2027.
